title: PJM capacity auction clearing prices, delivery years 2024/25 to 2028/29
description: Bar chart of the price at which PJM's base residual capacity auction cleared across its whole region, in dollars per megawatt-day of unforced capacity: $28.92 for 2024/25, $269.92 for 2025/26, then at the price cap: $329.17 for 2026/27, $333.44 for 2027/28 and $325.00 for 2028/29. Data: PJM, 2028/2029 Base Residual Auction report, table 2.
